headword: {潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}

definitions.explanation: Ability or talent that exists but has not yet been developed or demonstrated. Used in business, education, sports, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}には{大|おお}きな{潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}がある。
{潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す{教育|きょういく}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Education that draws out latent abilities is important.

examples.japanese: あの{選手|せんしゅ}は{潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}が{高|たか}く、{将来|しょうらい}が{楽|たの}しみだと{監督|かんとく}は{語|かた}った。
examples.english: The coach said that player has high potential and an exciting future ahead.

notes:
A compound of {潜在|せんざい} (latent, hidden) and {能力|のうりょく} (ability). Emphasizes untapped or unrealized ability, unlike {能力|のうりょく} alone which can refer to demonstrated ability.

Often shortened to ポテンシャル in casual speech, especially in business and sports contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す (to draw out potential)
- {潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}を{発揮|はっき}する (to demonstrate latent ability)
- {潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}が{高|たか}い (to have high potential)
- {潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}を{秘|ひ}める (to harbor hidden talent)
